## SMBsync+ 2.55-plus.17

- Keeps the sync log scrollable while files are being copied. Swipe up to review older entries; use Move Bottom to follow the latest messages again.
- Updates the log list in batches so large sync jobs remain responsive.
- Makes the running-sync header more compact on phone screens, with the current file and Cancel control still visible.

This APK uses the same package and signing certificate as previous SMBsync+ releases. Install it over the existing app to keep saved tasks and credentials.

SMBsync+ is based on [SMBSync2 by Sentaroh](https://github.com/Sentaroh/SMBSync2). Source and license notices remain in this repository.
